facts.fact: Togo First reports a BCEAO instruction of 8 October 2026 binding the eight WAEMU states raised the e-money balance cap to CFAF 4 million per issuer (from CFAF 2 million since 2015) and cut the demand-deposit float floor from 75% to 65%, effective 2 November 2026.
facts.system: BCEAO instruction on electronic money limits
